mapper.select: SELECT reservation_id , fair_id , visit_date , reservation_type FROM reservations WHERE status = 'PENDING_PAYMENT' AND payment_expires_at IS NOT NULL AND payment_expires_at <= #{now} ORDER BY payment_expires_at, reservation_id LIMIT #{limit} FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO reservation_histories ( reservation_id , action_type , before_data , after_data , changed_by , actor_type , is_admin_action , change_reason , created_at ) VALUES ( #{reservationId} , 'PAYMENT_EXPIRED' , JSON_OBJECT('status', 'PENDING_PAYMENT') , JSON_OBJECT('status', 'EXPIRED') , NULL , 'SYSTEM' , FALSE , '결제 제한시간 10분 초과' , #{now} )
